messages:
Priya (VP Infra): quick follow-up from today's infra update — starting this thread for regional GPU buffer / autoscale Q&A. drop questions and we'll answer live or async.

Tom (Platform): when you referred to an APAC "edge buffer" are those warm reserved nodes or fast reprovisioning?

Priya (VP Infra): a small warm pool in-region (reserved, single-digit per zone) plus fast fallback to nearest region. goal is predictable latency without large cost.

Rosa (SRE): if the pool is empty and we fallback cross-region what latency uplift should teams expect?

Priya (VP Infra): typical median uplift ~45-120ms depending on region pair. for ultra-low-latency customers we recommend Dedicated pinning.

Luca (Eng): can we get the autoscaler ramp config you demoed?

Arjun (Capacity): sharing the v0 conservative config used in demo:
```
min_pool_per_zone: 2
burst_threshold: 0.85
scale_step: 2
cooldown_secs: 180
max_pool_per_zone: 12
region_fallback_order: [ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1, us-west-2]
```

Tom (Platform): how does KV cache warmup play with fast scale-ups? first-request spikes?

Arjun (Capacity): cold KV adds overhead. we're pairing warm pools with prefix priming for top customer prompts so first requests avoid big spikes. priming runs during scale-up jobs.

Rosa (SRE): finance wants cost sims: warm pool year-round vs pure on-demand. numbers?

Priya (VP Infra): finance asked for a 3-scenario comparison. Tom, can you pull final numbers by Friday?

Tom (Platform): yep will compile and post the sheet. also need a short doc blurb on which models can use region buffers (some quantized/custom-kernel models excluded).

Priya (VP Infra): correct — models needing custom kernels or lots of scratch are excluded until validated. full list will be in model-catalog.

Luca (Eng): procurement ETA for H100? will Dedicated get H100 this quarter?

Arjun (Capacity): H100 arrival ETA: next quarter for initial capacity via partners. Dedicated customers can opt-in ~4 weeks after arrival post-safety checks.

Rosa (SRE): will autoscaler profiles change for H100 (bigger capacity per node)?

Priya (VP Infra): yes, hardware-specific profiles (scale_step, max_pool) will be tuned. Console will show recommended profiles.

Tom (Platform): rollout question: is rollback immediate or queued for A/B rollouts? want runbook wording.

Priya (VP Infra): immediate for safety-critical breaches (error spike >5% or latency >2x SLA). soft regressions use canary -> monitor -> controlled rollback or roll-forward. we'll add thresholds to runbooks.

Luca (Eng): can we get exact canary metrics (p50/p95, error rate, cost delta)?

Priya (VP Infra): posting tomorrow: p50/p95 latency, request error rate, token-cost delta vs baseline, correctness regressions (evals), queue depth.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job: "priming-job/apac-buffer-priming" started (job-id: jb-2026-09-01-0910).

Rosa (SRE): priming shows as short GPU spikes in dashboard — can we throttle so autoscaler ignores priming and doesn't scale out?

Arjun (Capacity): will add priming traffic tag and soft caps so autoscaler excludes priming up to a limit.

Priya (VP Infra): actions: 1) Tom to produce finance comparison (warm vs on-demand) by Fri. 2) Priya to publish model-eligibility doc and canary metric list by tomorrow. 3) Arjun to tag priming traffic for autoscaler ignore. 4) Infra to prepare H100 profile draft post-arrival. I'll consolidate notes into the all-hands summary.

Tom (Platform): spreadsheet link (draft): https://redwood.company/sheets/gpu-warm-pools — will share edit access.

Luca (Eng): thanks everyone, super helpful. :thumbsup:

Priya (VP Infra): thanks all. small follow-ups here, bigger asks in #eng-oncall or open an RFC. closing after actions assigned.
